items.text: Cardinals trade WR Marvin Harrison Jr. + 2027 7th to Texans for 2027 2nd + 6th. Rapoport co-reported. MHJ changes bio.
items.why: Blockbuster confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport; Texans add to Collins/Boutte/Dell room.
items.implication: Immediate role upgrade potential in HOU offense; ARI WR vacuum.
items.opportunity: Targets in Texans pass game; monitor snap share debut.

items.text: ETR FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play. Schefter listed among actives.
items.why: Pregame workout cleared; hopeful reports from Rapoport earlier.
items.implication: Raiders RB1 carries/routes intact vs NE.

items.text: ETR FINAL UPDATE: Terry McLaurin will play. Schefter confirmed active.
items.why: Cleared after limited practice and optimism from Quinn.
items.implication: Commanders WR1 with Diggs out; Daniels returning.

items.text: ETR FINAL/UPDATES: Ja'Marr Chase will play in Week 5.
items.why: Weekend reports and final updates confirmed both Chase and Higgins clear.
items.implication: Full Bengals WR1 usage expected; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary option with Burrow.

items.text: ETR UPDATES: Tee Higgins will play Week 5.
items.why: Confirmed alongside Chase in final pregame updates.

items.text: ETR: Justin Jefferson expected to play; Jordan Addison not expected to play. Schefter confirmed actives include Jefferson, inactives Addison.
items.why: Pregame updates and official actives/inactives. Jefferson scored.
items.implication: Jefferson full WR1 snaps/routes; Addison zero.
items.opportunity: Jefferson target monopoly upside without Addison.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. out remainder of game (hamstring). Rapoport confirmed ruled out. ETR watching.
items.implication: Remaining snaps redistribute to other SF pass-catchers.

items.text: Zay Flowers officially active (Ravens). ETR expected to play.
Matthew Berry: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for GB RB depth/upside.

items.text: Levitan: Coaching staffs refuse workhorse on Jaylen Warren despite him passing every test (advanced stats, eye test); Ekeler-esque. Was splitting with Rico Dowdle pre-injury (Dowdle not expected).
items.why: Dowdle out/not expected; Warren elite efficiency ignored previously.
items.implication: PIT RB1 volume spike with Dowdle sidelined.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, goal-line with clear path.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps. ETR not expected to play.
items.why: Foot/rib issues; limited role if any.
items.implication: Avoid; targets to other Chargers WRs.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries in LAC WR room for volume.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury. ETR watching list.
items.implication: HOU RB committee shifts; zero for Montgomery.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup carries and possible pass-game work.

items.text: Levitan DFS cash review: Jahmyr Gibbs only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups despite being best salary-adjusted value; must-play at high salary.
items.why: Projections showed massive value edge; low ownership surprising.
items.implication: Strong cash/tournament play; Lions offense elite.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry share in best offense.

items.text: Matthew Berry reacts to holy hell TD catch by Trey McBride.
items.why: Highlight-reel score in DET-ARI game underscoring involvement.
items.implication: Continue strong TE1 start; high-upside target.
